mentions.name: Lekker Duelist
mentions.description: A two-sided online marketplace for buying and selling Yu-Gi-Oh! trading cards in South Africa, modeled on TCGPlayer and Cardmarket. Also serves as a sandbox for trying fresh marketplace ideas outside the author's day job.
mentions.problem: South Africa lacks a dedicated Yu-Gi-Oh! card marketplace; two-sided marketplaces are notoriously hard to seed, and existing competition covers other TCGs.
mentions.audience: Yu-Gi-Oh! players and card traders in South Africa
